blocks.x: The intermediate sales techniques program focuses on advanced discovery, objection typologies, personalizing the value message, multichannel outreach, and basic negotiation skills. The goal is a consistent and measurable increase in productivity during field conversations.
Within the first 30–60 days, visible improvements are targeted in conversation depth, objection resolution rate, and next‑step (appointment/offer) rates.

items: Advanced Discovery: Persona/role‑based question sets and a needs map.

Negotiation Fundamentals: Win‑win framework and concession plan.
CRM Discipline: Stage, probability, and note standards.
Reporting & Dashboard: Skill, behavior, and outcome dashboards.
Templates & Playbook: Conversation flow, objection cards, and A/B plan templates.
Risk & Scenario Planning: What‑if analyses for engagement, next step, and conversion.
Enablement Playbook: Message house, content, and A/B guide template set.
Coaching Agenda: Standard for 1:1 agenda and feedback rhythm.
Experiment Logbook: Recorded tracking of A/B variations and learnings.
